Strong verb: **waschen – wusch – gewaschen**, du wäschst / er wäscht (a → ä).

Core sense is *to wash*. The family is highly transparent — prefixes and
derivations keep the base meaning, so learning the root carries most of the load.

| Word | Meaning | Note |
|---|---|---|
| waschen | to wash (something) | takes Akk. |
| sich waschen | to wash oneself | reflexive |
| abwaschen | to wash up, do dishes | separable |
| die Wäsche | laundry | no plural |
| die Waschmaschine | washing machine | |
| das Waschbecken | sink, washbasin | |

**Watch out:** *abwaschen* (dishes) vs *Wäsche waschen* (clothes) — English "do the
washing" collapses both. Germans distinguish them.

## Examples
- Ich **wasche** mir die Hände. (I'm washing my hands.) [alltag, gesprochen]
- **Wäschst** du bitte ab? (Will you do the dishes?) [alltag, du-Ebene]
- Die **Wäsche** ist noch in der **Waschmaschine**. (The laundry is still in the machine.) [alltag]
